_comment: Stuffy Doll, design step 10 (StuffyDollProvider::ExtraLethalDamage). The DEPTH-0 RUNNER (the greedy
policy, TurnSolver::Solve) must find the Act kill. Doll (chose the opponent) + four opponent Spirits = 5
creatures, so Blasphemous Act costs {3}{R} off four lands; its 13 reflects off the indestructible Doll
and kills the opponent at 13. Screaming Nemesis ({2}{R}) competes for the same mana (five lands after the drawn Plains): the Act deals
0 to the face directly, so without the provider's lethal projection the greedy picker ranks the
Nemesis subset higher (control: MTG_PROVIDER_DECK pinned to the old ModernRwBurn routing -> no win by
turn 4). With it the Act subset is projected lethal and the runner casts it on turn 4. Also guards the
step-10 AffinityFeedCount fix: the Doll's ping activation must not price 'Nemesis + ping + Act' as
payable off five lands (it did, and the runner cast Nemesis and then could not pay the Act).
